label: Custom
description: Your own prompt, with optional reference images.

label: Cinematic camera
description: A still shot as if on a real camera body, lens and aperture.
template: {prompt}. Shot on {body} with a {focal} {lens} lens at {aperture}: matching depth of field, perspective and rendering, cinematic color.

label: Character
description: Puts one of your Elements in a new scene, same face and look.

fields.label: Scene
fields.placeholder: sitting in a Tokyo café at night, neon outside

template: The same person as in the reference images, same face, hair and features: {scene}. {prompt}

label: Product shot
description: Your product on a clean studio set or in a styled scene.

fields.label: Set
fields.placeholder: on wet black stone, soft rim light

template: Professional product photo of the product in the reference images, exact shape, colors and labels kept: {set}, {angle} view. {prompt}

label: Custom edit
description: Changes what you describe, the rest of the image stays.
template: Edit the first image: {prompt}. Keep everything else identical.

label: Relight
description: Moves the light: direction, softness, brightness and color.
template: Relight the image with a {softness} light coming from the {direction}, brightness {brightness}%, light color {color}. Shadows and highlights follow the new light; subject, pose and background stay identical. {prompt}

label: Inpaint
description: Draw over an area, say what goes there.
template: The second image is the first with an area marked in color. Change only the marked area: {change}. The marks themselves must not appear; everything outside the area stays identical. {prompt}

label: Upscale
description: Redraws the image in 4K with sharper detail.
template: Upscale this image to high resolution: same content, composition and colors, sharper detail and texture, no new elements. {prompt}

label: Face swap
description: Puts a face from one photo onto the person of another.
template: Replace the face of the person in the first image with the face of the person in the second image. Keep the first image's pose, expression, lighting, skin tone match, hair and background. {prompt}

label: Character swap
description: Replaces the whole person with one of your characters.
template: Replace the person in the first image with the character of the other images (face, hair, body, outfit), in the same pose, place and lighting. {prompt}

label: Expand
description: Extends the image beyond its edges to a new ratio.

fields.label: What's beyond
fields.placeholder: more of the beach and the sky

template: Outpaint: extend this image beyond its edges to fill the new frame, continuing the scene naturally ({beyond}). The original image stays untouched in the center. {prompt}

label: New angle
description: The same scene seen from another camera angle.
template: The same scene, same subject and moment, seen {angle}. Consistent identity, outfit, lighting and place. {prompt}

label: Edit text
description: Changes a text in the image, same font and place.
template: Replace the text "{old}" with "{new}" in the same font, size, color, perspective and place. Nothing else changes. {prompt}

label: Remove background
description: Cuts the subject out on a transparent background.
template: Cut out the main subject of the image on a fully transparent background, clean edges, the subject unchanged. {prompt}
